_comment: Rules of scripts/check-content.py. Paths are relative to the repository's root; '**' crosses folders, '*' does not. A binary file or an image is added to reviewed_files only after someone looked at it and wrote what it is; a changed file must be reviewed again (its SHA-256 changes).

manifested_archives.what: The engine's source as the install wizard compiles it (scripts/bundle-runtime.ps1); the launcher's tests scan every entry (shipped_bundle_is_clean).
hactool and the shader translator, built from the engine's sources (examples/bundle_tools.rs), with their licenses.
